description: Verify React Native DevTools integration and create a simple test screen with logging to confirm the debugging setup works end-to-end
steps: Read app/_layout.tsx to confirm Sentry.wrap is in place (no changes needed)
Read src/lib/sentry.ts to confirm scrubBreadcrumb handles log breadcrumbs (no changes needed)
Create a test debug screen at app/debug.tsx with examples of each log method
Run the app with npx expo start
Press J to open React Native DevTools
Verify logs appear in Console tab with correct format
Verify Sentry breadcrumbs appear for warn/error calls
Verify dev-only logs are stripped in production (npx expo start --no-dev)
acceptance_criteria: React Native DevTools opens when pressing J in the terminal
Console tab shows log/warn/error/debug output with timestamps and file context
Sentry breadcrumbs are created for warn/error logs
Dev-only logs are stripped in production builds
No breaking changes to existing functionality
verification: Press J, verify DevTools opens with Console tab
Navigate to debug screen, verify log messages appear
Run npx expo start --no-dev, verify dev-only logs are hidden
